changes: Migrated the project to Composer PSR-4 autoloading and removed the legacy XC_Autoloader
Integrated PHPStan into the CI pipeline with a frozen baseline and resolved hundreds of static analysis issues
Introduced production-only release builds to reduce package size by excluding development dependencies
Continued modernization of the Core, Domain, and Infrastructure architecture with dependency injection, EventDispatcher, enums, and strict typing
Added automatic generation of unique self-signed TLS certificates during installation
Enhanced the module system with versioning, migrations, BaseModule, and ListensTo attribute support
Added automatic GeoLite2 database downloads during installation and updates
Improved HLS startup performance through optimized initial segment processing
Added missing Load Balancer administration routes
Fixed numerous PSR-4 autoloading, namespace, and path-related issues
Improved streaming stability, TMDB integration, installer reliability, and binary download handling
Removed obsolete development tools and legacy code
Improved documentation, migration guides, GitHub workflows, and release automation
Updated project dependencies and strengthened CI/CD security and stability
